acceptance.evidence: The GOWM-owned repository contains only static schema-qualified reads of gowm_spatial_v1 views; the architecture validator rejects base-table or non-contract schema references.

Migration 012 explicitly revokes canonical base tables and grants only the four views/functions to spatial_provider, and database assertion 003 verifies privileges. The assertion was not executed against live PostgreSQL in this run.

Security-barrier views filter with the transaction-local trusted scope, repository execution sets scope before reads, and cross-scope cursor use is rejected. The live two-scope PostgreSQL assertion was not run.
Migration 012 creates append-only wrf_* public identities; provider schemas and results expose ReferenceKey and never expose the canonical World Object primary key.

The view and provider mapping carry freshnessMs, confidence, source, provenance summary, source observation provenance, and World Evidence. Provider execution tests pass; a live database result was not captured.
Current-projection results and Data Snapshot resources report CONSISTENT_AT_START with AT_LEAST pinning; static validation forbids a PINNED claim in the repository.
Fresh PostgreSQL migration application was not runnable without a database URL or Docker API access.
Upgrade of an existing v0.1 dataset was not runnable without a database URL or Docker API access.
